title: Move navigation from a top bar to a left sidebar
body:
The top bar feels wrong for the retheme's HUD aesthetic. Owner wants a left sidebar instead.

MainNav moves from a top bar to a persistent left sidebar, full labels always visible (no icon-only collapse, no drawer), narrower on mobile than desktop. The active route gets a glowing highlight, which requires MainNav to become a Client Component. The layout flips from flex-col to flex-row in app/layout.tsx. No route, testid or behavior changes.
